title: When Does an Aesthetic Become a System?
author: RN Collins
rightsRule: Evidence leads; atmosphere never substitutes for provenance.

carouselA.title: When Does an Aesthetic Become a System?: the institutional sequence

frames.caption: An aesthetic becomes a system when recurring choices are connected to roles, evidence, tests, handoffs, exceptions, and feedback—so the practice can learn without reducing itself to visual sameness.
frames.alt: Title plate for When Does an Aesthetic Become a System?.
frames.treatment: typography, rule, folio and domain color only

frames.caption: The sheet demonstrates a contract-shaped network of design, printing, manufacture, advertising, attribution, and distribution—even when the operative agreements are absent from the image.

frames.caption: 01 · INPUT — What enters the aesthetic system?. Inventory references, materials, bodies, techniques, constraints, memories, commissions, budgets, deadlines, collaborators, and cultural knowledge. Attach origin, permission, credit, context, and transformation status to every consequential input.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what enters the aesthetic system? within When Does an Aesthetic Become a System?.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 02 · RULE — How does an input change a decision?. Translate a mood into a testable relation: if the material has this weight, the silhouette permits this movement; if the image uses this distance, the body retains this agency. Preserve exceptions and who may authorize them.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping how does an input change a decision? within When Does an Aesthetic Become a System?.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 03 · LOOP — How does the system learn?. Connect sample, fitting, wearer response, production constraint, image review, sales signal, repair evidence, criticism, and archive return. Record which feedback changed the work and which was rejected with reason.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping how does the system learn? within When Does an Aesthetic Become a System?.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 04 · RIGHTS — Which outputs or identifiers may be protected?. Map exact works, marks, registrations, contracts, designs, files, and confidential methods separately. Do not convert system documentation into a claim that the overall aesthetic is automatically copyrighted or registrable.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

frames.caption: Systems can make work scalable and reviewable; they can also become bureaucracy, optimize toward what platforms reward, and harden a founder’s bias into process. A healthy aesthetic system includes exit ramps, minority reports, ethical review, and protected zones for experiment that do not need immediate justification.
frames.alt: Counterpoint card for When Does an Aesthetic Become a System?.
frames.treatment: typographic quotation field; no decorative imagery

frames.caption: At each handoff, name the person, decision, evidence, version, and return path.
frames.alt: Fieldwork prompt for When Does an Aesthetic Become a System?.
